headline: Every pack of wafer bars checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Wafer bars, single and share packs
label: #F3E9DA
heroLede: Your recent upgrade already brought automation to the site. A camera check after the wrapper works alongside what you have. Here's what it could look like on your wrapping line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is wrapped and sealed, with no open ends or torn film. An open wrapper lets the wafer go soft and comes back as a complaint.
labelLede: A milk pack and a dark pack look much the same at line speed, and a mixed-up pack means a wrong product on the shelf. The camera checks every pack carries the right wrapper for the bars inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every block. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Foil offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four open ends in fifteen minutes. Check the wrapper.
